title: tldr
short_description: A private, calm feed of short news.
long_description: tldr replaces mindless doom-scrolling with a personal feed of short, trusted news briefings. Editorial serif type, source-transparent cards, bilingual EN/HE with true RTL. No account. No streaks. No noise. Everything stays on your device.
release_notes:
v1.0.2 — RSS UTF-8 fix + drop read-time from byline

- Hebrew RSS feeds fetched client-side were being decoded as Latin-1
  because the Dart http package falls back to Latin-1 when the
  response Content-Type has no charset (Israel Hayom serves
  'text/xml' without one — Ynet/Globes/Walla/Haaretz all do too on
  various responses). All 5 feeds declare UTF-8 in their XML
  preamble, so we now decode res.bodyBytes as UTF-8 explicitly
  (allowMalformed: true so one bad byte can't sink a whole feed).
  Fixes gibberish Israel Hayom titles + any other Hebrew mojibake.

- Removed the '~45s' read-time estimate from card bylines (feed +
  video + expanded views). User feedback: noise on top of the
  headline; publisher + date + confidence is enough.
